reviews.review_text:

Food cooked from the heart
Feb 2020 • Couples
Tucked away in a quiet alleyway, this restaurant is worth searching out. It is very well placed in District 1, within walking distance of all the sights. Mrs Oanh is a delightful hostess and her food some of the best we've tasted, in 3 weeks in Vietnam.
 
Don't forget to check out the golf trophies...(and if you're inclined, perhaps fix up a round with Mrs Oanh and her son, he's a handsome young Professional)

Oh and do ask her to lead you in a song or two on the guitar...
You will have the best night in Ho Chi Minh city, I promise!

Deliciious food, Warm environment
Dec 2018 • Friends
We were a group of 8 and stayed in a room for us so that we could feel totally comfortable. The service team was truly friendly all long the meal and had pleasure explaining us the traditional dishes from Hue. Altogether we enjoyed very much the lunch, and I still remember the delicately fresh flavour of the herbs that composed my dish, which I never met before. At the end of the lunch we were offered a cup of tea with ginger cookies, and the Head of the Restaurant come to compliment us, we shared experiences of our trip, and ended singing and playing songs with one of the guitars she had there, making it one unforgettable experience we take with us. Thank you!

Absolutely Fantastic
Sep 2016 • Solo
Happened across this little restaurant and ate here most night while in Ho Chi Minh City. I can't recommend it highly enough. Great service, charming owner and delicious food. A small simple menu, well priced in a charming environment. I was given suggestions on what to order, then, how best to enjoy the food interspersed with great conversation about everything from golf- the owner is a multi winner at the fine old game-, to chatting about her gorgeous Lambretta and Vespa classic scooters. Great choice to enjoy first class Vietnamese cuisine.
